In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], a '''skirmish''' took place in a [[secret Imperial detention center]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. A group of [[underdweller]]s led by the [[IT-3 Interrogator]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[It (IT-3 Interrogator)|"It"]] brought a stolen [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]], as well as the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Youngling/Legends|youngling]] [[Lumpawaroo/Legends|Lumpawarrump]] to the detention center, and were followed by Lumpawarrump's [[Parent/Legends|parents]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and [[Mallatobuck/Legends|Mallatobuck]]. The skirmish saw "It" destroyed and the datapad retrieved.<ref name="AFA" />
